remarks:
Discover an exceptional lifestyle in this head-turning ranch home, beautifully situated on four picturesque acres just outside of Jamestown in the town of Kiantone. Offering breathtaking, miles-long countryside views and spectacular morning sunrises, this property boasts massive curb appeal and is deceivingly spacious from the roadside.

Inside, the main level provides over 2,500 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. A welcoming foyer opens into multiple areas tailored for both relaxation and entertaining. The sun-drenched formal living room highlights impressive panoramic views and a beautiful fireplace, providing a perfect backdrop for holiday gatherings. For a more rustic retreat, the inviting family room features charming wood-beam ceilings and a classic wood-burning fireplace. The kitchen includes a casual eat-in space, an adjoining semi-formal dining room, and a conveniently located laundry room just steps away. Completing the main floor is a spacious primary en-suite, alongside two additional bedrooms and an impressive three and a half baths.

The luxury of space continues in the nearly fully finished walk-out lower level. This expansive downstairs retreat features a large recreation room, a second kitchen, and an additional family room that flows seamlessly into your backyard oasis. Additionally you'll find another full bathroom, tons of storage space and the mechanical room. 

 Step outside to resort-style living, where you can spend your summers lounging by the private inground pool, playing matches on your personal tennis court, or utilizing the versatile barn to suit your unique hobbies or storage needs. With its unparalleled amenities, warm interiors, and sweeping pastoral views, this extraordinary country estate is truly a rare find.

No showings 10/8-10/11 as there will be a sale at the house.
